title: OPN Balloon for SAFE Recanalization of Calcified Coronary Lesions
official: OPN Balloon for SAFE Recanalization of Calcified Coronary Lesions (OPEN-SAFE Registry)
summary: The goal of the OPEN-SAFE registry is to describe the contemporary use and outcomes of SIS-OPN in North America.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 years or older
* Subjects who underwent a clinically indicated PCI procedure that involved at least one OPN balloon
* Date range for data collection will be from February 1, 2023 to December 31, 2028

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects who have opted out of being included in research related data collection
